label: Ink & Coral
description: Near-black with a rose-coral accent on warm off-white. Confident and trend-led rather than precious — suits women's fashion labels, clothing wholesalers and retailers, and size-inclusive brands.
notes:
Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables.

WHY NOT 'blush-noir': that theme also lists fashion, but its Cormorant Garamond and dusty rose read as a quiet editorial boutique. A market-based clothing wholesaler selling trend-led womenswear to retailers is not that business — it needs to look current and confident, not hushed. Near-black primary with a geometric sans is the register a customer already recognises from every fashion app on their phone.

ACCENT IS CONTRAST-CHECKED: --color-accent is the colour of the 12px meta line on product cards, so it must clear WCAG AA at small text. The obvious brighter coral (#D94F6A) measures 3.74:1 on this background and fails; #C2405C measures 4.72:1 and passes. Primary is 16.28:1, muted 5.19:1, white-on-primary 17.33:1. Re-measure before changing the accent.

Both fonts serve weights 400-700 on Google Fonts (checked).
